about_the_game:
WARNING: This page is a placeholder for festival use. Visuals and text are not final.

Instruments of Power is a tactical RPG with roguelite elements set in a dark, crumbling fantasy world. You are a mage who made a world-shaking discovery — only to lose your body and unleash an ancient evil upon the land.

Your physical body is gone...

Now bound to a mysterious sanctuary beyond space and flesh, you must craft custom spells, upgrade your physical avatars, and scry the land for Sites of Power to reclaim.

Each is a battleground—tainted, contested, and overrun by warped things born of the darkness you unleashed. Reclaim them through ruthless, turn-based combat.

Uncover the truth behind the force you released—and face the consequences.

How far will you go to undo what you’ve done?

Repel the shadows

The game unfolds across two layers: the sanctuary and the tactical battlefield.

In the sanctuary, you interact with the Entity that saved your soul and prepare for what comes next. Manage your territory and spend your resources to craft spells, upgrade your avatars and extend your influence over the region.

When ready, choose an enemy force to confront. The game then shifts to a tactical, turn-based battle where your avatars clash with hostile forces while activating ancient artefacts and structures.

Features

- Craft your own spells by combining catalysts, effects, and mods earned in battle—tailor your arsenal to counter powerful enemies and their unique abilities.

- Engage in deep, turn-based combat where positioning, timing, and synergy determine survival.

- Control your force: choose when, where, and how many avatars to bring into battle.

- Face a diverse enemy roster—each foe has distinct abilities and AI behavior.

- Battle across hand-crafted maps featuring layered objectives and tactical challenges.

- Endure loss: death sets you back as enemies reclaim territory—but the war continues.

- Spend Influence, generated by your captured Sites of Power, to unlock new regions and cast devastating curses upon enemy forces.

- Upgrade your avatars with Aether: enhance their stats and equip passive powers that reshape your tactics.

- Confront the Entity that saved you, deepen your knowledge of the world, and uncover the truth behind the darkness you set free.

- Shape the ending: your choices lead to one of two radically different outcomes for the world—and for yourself.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features stylized but frequent combat involving magical violence. Players confront shadowy enemies in a dark world. Themes of death, identity, and moral ambiguity are explored. Some narrative elements may be unsettling.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading times.

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Instruments of Power blends tactical combat and spell crafting. Project yourself into fragile avatars and unleash custom spells to defeat vicious enemies in turn-based battles. Discover forgotten magic and reclaim lost sites of power in this tactical RPG with rogue-lite elements.
